title: Colorful Unown Shinies
description: A resource pack that adds various colors to Unown's shinies, depending on form. Based on the work of Serentix on YouTube.
body:
**Colorful Unown Shinies** is a standalone resource pack that adds various colors to Unown's shinies, depening on its form. This change is purely cosmetic and does not affect gameplay. Based on the work of [Serentix](https://www.youtube.com/@Serentix) on YouTube. 

- **Colorful Unown Shinies** does not require being installed as a datapack, making it compatible with multiplayer servers. 

Enjoy this resource pack? Be sure to check out my other work: [The Power of Unown](https://modrinth.com/datapack/the-power-of-unown-unown-rework)!

**Questions or Comments?**

Be sure to join Cobblemon's Discord and share your thoughts in "Ian's things" under the forum channel named "content-zone-help"
